title: Asleep in Jesus
description: Asleep in Jesus in Tonic Solfa to REST (BRADBURY): the solfa with the words, staff notation, the five verses, and a piano.
about: Margaret Mackay’s words were published in 1832. The tune REST is by William B. Bradbury (1843).
underlay: A-sleep in Je-sus! Bless-ed sleep, From which none ev-er wakes to weep; A calm and un-dis-turbed re-pose, Un-bro-ken by the last of foes.

lines: Asleep in Jesus! Blessed sleep,
From which none ever wakes to weep;
A calm and undisturbed repose,
Unbroken by the last of foes.
Asleep in Jesus! Oh, how sweet,
To be for such a slumber meet,
With holy confidence to sing
That death has lost his venomed sting!
Asleep in Jesus! Peaceful rest,
Whose waking is supremely blest;
No fear, no woe, shall dim that hour
That manifests the Saviour’s pow’r.
Asleep in Jesus! Oh, for me
May such a blessed refuge be!
Securely shall my ashes lie,
And wait the summons from on high.
Asleep in Jesus! Far from thee
Thy kindred and their graves may be;
But there is still a blessed sleep,
From which none ever wakes to weep.
